name: idp

scripts.build: echo 'no build step — Bun runs TypeScript directly'

//: A workspace member since #187, installed by the root `bun install` against the root lockfile. It used to sit outside the workspace with its own bun.lock, because Better Auth needs zod 4 and the root pinned zod 3; the root now pins zod 4. What has not changed: this service stands in for the enterprise's real identity provider, and a forker deletes the directory and points Arcade at their Okta, so nothing in the template may depend on it and it must depend on nothing in the template. `test/knows-people-not-loans.test.ts` holds both halves.
`external: true` is read by packages/policy-schema's workspace sweep, which otherwise requires every app to declare @cg/policy-schema. This one must not: it knows people, not policy.
